never: match a document to a record by a name, an address or an amount
enter a value it cannot read, or a total its lines do not add up to
overwrite a value the record already holds
edit, rename over or delete an original
reply to, pay, approve or send anything to a customer or supplier
file under a kind the list does not hold
stays_with_person: clearing every exception, including which of two values is right
writing the list of kinds and what is entered for each
every reply, and every decision to pay
deleting anything, and how long documents are kept

provider_block.job: every document that arrives is on the right record, typed in once, or on one list for a person

with_us.note: No hosted step. Landing each document on its record by id in the business's own job system, entering only into blank fields and attaching the original unaltered, is quoted as a scoped build on the systems the office already runs.

checks.title: Every document is counted the moment it arrives
Each document gets exactly one kind from a list the business writes
It is matched to its record by a number printed on it, never by a name or a guess
Details are entered into the record only when they read clearly and add up
A value already in the record is never overwritten by a document that disagrees
The same document arriving twice is filed once
The original is kept exactly as it arrived, and linked from the record
Anything that needs a person waits on one list, with a reason and an owner, oldest first
The run files and enters details, and never replies, pays, approves or sends
The day closes with every document accounted for, published even when it is all clear
A person clearing an exception is recorded, and the document then files as normal
For any document, where it came from and what happened to it can be looked up
